primitiveBudget: one generated mineral body, thirteen generated negative apertures, one central seam, raster grain
renderer: p5.js Canvas 2D raster fossil with WebGPU capability signal
memoryRule: a held pause stays geometry-neutral until release; duration hardens a remote aperture and central seam while the source aperture remains exact; four events persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch holds inside the fossil and releases after 640ms; Enter or Space commits an equivalent deterministic hold; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: signal lattice, pressure reservoirs, and shader depth sheets -> one singular raster mineral body whose negative apertures are the archive
compositionRupture: distributed field, overlapping bodies, and continuous cross-section -> centered vertical fossil with a tense seam and irregular voids
encounterRupture: multi-site selection, pair compression, and three-witness accord -> one temporal hold whose duration is the material input
temporalRupture: remote relay, pressure relation, and depth reorder -> threshold pause that hardens four liftable fossil events
mediumRupture: p5.js WebGL fragment shader -> p5.js Canvas 2D offscreen raster buffer and generated cut geometry
changedRule: The hand never paints and no site is selected. Only a hold that crosses the duration threshold and releases can harden a remote aperture; elapsed waiting changes the material hardness.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a singular mineral fossil with thirteen negative apertures. A valid hold leaves its source exact while a distant aperture, seam, and nearby cuts change in actual raster geometry; brief and long holds visibly differ and four events persist.
falsifier: Delete if the blind body reads as a grid, particle field, or texture; if geometry changes before release; if a short hold commits; if duration is cosmetic; if the held site is the answer; if remote change is cosmetic; if later events reset; or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v041 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish pressure-fossil from v038-v040 or if waiting does not make a material remote cut.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
